title: phlox hoodii subsp. lanata
intro: Phlox hoodii subsp. lanata, commonly known as Bear's Foot, is a flowering plant species native to the northwestern regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The health benefits of Phlox hoodii subsp. lanata include its ability to soothe inflammation and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
